findings.title: Lithuanian TOTP step 1 is replaced by Italian text
findings.body: The new value `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, copied from messages_it. The rest of this Lithuanian file is Lithuanian (see lines 102-103), so Lithuanian users will see Italian on the account TOTP setup page. Replace it with Lithuanian text, for example `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo mobiliajame telefone:`. The English source is at themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/account/messages/messages_en.properties:150.
findings.originReason: The diff replaced the Lithuanian totpStep1 value with this Italian sentence.

verification.reason: Line 101 of the Lithuanian account bundle is now Italian ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"), but the lines around it are Lithuanian. Lithuanian users will see Italian on this page. The wording is not an exact copy of messages_it (that file says "dispositivo mobile"), but it is still Italian.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP step 1 is replaced by Italian text
findings.body: Same problem as the account file: `loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian in a Lithuanian file (neighbouring lines 72-73 are Lithuanian). Lithuanian users get Italian on the login OTP setup page. Use Lithuanian text.
findings.originReason: The diff replaced the Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 value with Italian text.

verification.reason: loginTotpStep1 in the Lithuanian login bundle is now Italian, while lines 72-73 next to it are Lithuanian. Lithuanian users get Italian on the OTP setup page.

findings.title: zh_CN TOTP step 1 is written in Traditional Chinese
findings.body: `totpStep1=在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The rest of this Simplified Chinese file uses Simplified forms (for example line 113 `打开应用扫描二维码输入验证码`). Use Simplified text such as `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.
findings.originReason: The diff introduced the new totpStep1 value written in Traditional Chinese characters.

verification.reason: The new zh_CN totpStep1 uses Traditional forms (手機, 安裝, 應用程式), but the rest of the file is Simplified Chinese (for example line 113, and loginTotpStep1 in the login zh_CN bundle uses 移动设备/安装/应用).

findings.title: English key switched to single-brace placeholders the account UI cannot interpolate
findings.body: The key was changed from `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` to `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` plus a MessageFormat choice `{2,choice,...}`. The account UI loads messages through i18next (js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:27-29 uses the default `{{ }}` interpolation, no ICU plugin). Every other placeholder in this file uses `{{ }}`, for example line 27 `error-invalid-length-too-short='{{0}}' must have minimal length of {{1}}.` and line 133. So the UI would show the literal `{0}` and `{2,choice,...}`. Revert to `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` and drop the choice syntax, or confirm that this key is not rendered through i18next. The Java-side keys in themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/admin/messages/messages_en.properties are a different consumer and are fine with single braces.
findings.originReason: The diff changed {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to {0}/{1}/{2} plus a MessageFormat choice.

verification.reason: The account UI loads messages raw from ThemeResource.getLocalizationTexts, which applies no {n}->{{n}} conversion. It renders server validation errors with i18next t(errorMessage, {...params}) using the default {{ }} interpolation and no ICU plugin. So {0} and {2,choice,...} would show up literally.

findings.title: Admin UI English key uses single braces; the file's other 25 keys use i18next syntax
findings.body: Same issue as the account UI key: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` now uses `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and a choice block, while the rest of this file uses `{{...}}` (for example line 3129 `userNotSaved=...{{error}}` and line 3147 `{{fieldName}}`; 25 occurrences in total). The admin UI interpolates with i18next (js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-18, default `{{ }}`), so the placeholders would not be substituted. Restore `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}`, or show that the key is not passed through i18next.
findings.originReason: The diff switched this admin UI key from {{n}} to {n} with choice syntax.

verification.reason: The admin UI uses i18next with default interpolation (i18n.ts:16) and loads raw values from the same ThemeResource endpoint, which has no conversion. The shared setUserProfileServerError passes params as {0,1,2} to t(), so single-brace placeholders are not substituted.

findings.title: Error message construction can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: The common-suffix loop (lines 106-109) can overlap the common-prefix loop (lines 102-105). When `sanitized` is shorter than `value` and its prefix and suffix overlap, `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` gets a begin index greater than the end index and throws. Example: value `aba`, sanitized `a`: start=1, end=1, so `substring(1, 0)` throws. The failure is not silent (the build fails with an exception), but the exception replaces the Illegal HTML report and drops the other collected messages. Clamp `end` to `sanitized.length() - start` (and `start` to `value.length() - end`) before building the substrings.
findings.originReason: This diff adds the new prefix/suffix stripping code.

verification.reason: The prefix and suffix loops are bounded separately, so start+end can exceed sanitized.length(). With value "aba" and sanitized "a" you get start=1 and end=1, and sanitized.substring(1,0) throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.

findings.title: Anchor pattern also matches any tag starting with 'a'
findings.body: `</?a[^>]*>` has no word boundary, so it matches `<abbr>`, `<address>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<audio>` as well as `<a ...>`. Those tags are then compared as anchors against the English value and can be reported as 'Didn't find anchor tag' or silently removed before the sanitizer runs. Use `</?a(\s[^>]*)?>` or `</?a\b[^>]*>`.

verification.reason: `</?a[^>]*>` has no boundary after the `a`, so it also matches <abbr>, <address>, <aside> and similar tags, and treats them as anchors in santizeAnchors.

findings.title: Unreadable or missing English file throws a RuntimeException that bypasses the Mojo error path
findings.body: verify() catches only IOException and converts it to MojoExecutionException (lines 52-53). verifySafeHtml() throws RuntimeException at lines 70 and 79 for the target file and for the English counterpart. Those exceptions pass through ThemeVerifierMojo.execute()'s loop (ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51) without being collected, so the run stops at the first such file and the aggregated 'Validation errors' report is never produced. Consider adding the message to `messages` (or wrapping in MojoExecutionException) so the other files are still checked and the error is reported the same way as the other failures.
findings.originReason: verifySafeHtml and its RuntimeException throws are new in this diff.

verification.reason: verifySafeHtml throws RuntimeException when the file or its English counterpart cannot be read. verify() catches only IOException, and ThemeVerifierMojo.execute() calls verify() inside a loop without catching anything. So the run stops at the first such file and the aggregated 'Validation errors' report is never produced.

findings.title: No test that a valid translation passes
findings.body:
All four tests assert that a violation is reported. Nothing checks the allowed cases the new code is built around: a translation with `
` or `` when the English value has HTML, a translation whose anchor matches the English anchor exactly, and a plain translation with no HTML. A regression that flags every translation would still pass these tests. Add a positive fixture (and an `error-invalid-multivalued-size` choice case, since normalizeValue special-cases it).
findings.originReason: The new tests added by this diff only cover failing cases.

verification.reason: All four tests only assert that a violation is reported (hasItem). No fixture checks that a valid translation (allowed HTML, a matching anchor, plain text, or the choice special case) produces an empty list.

findings.title: Policy and pattern fields are mutable instance fields with package visibility
findings.body: `POLICY_SOME_HTML`, `POLICY_NO_HTML` (lines 58, 63) and `HTML_TAGS` (line 139) are non-final, non-private instance fields. They are immutable configuration and should be `private static final`, like `ANCHOR_PATTERN` on line 145. Also `santizeAnchors` (line 150) is misspelled.
findings.originReason: These fields and the method are added in this diff.

verification.reason: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS are package-private, non-final instance fields, while ANCHOR_PATTERN is private static final. santizeAnchors is misspelled. This is a style nit with no behavioural impact.

contracts.action: Verifier runs the new sanitizer and anchor checks on every messages_*.properties file during the build
contracts.equivalent_path: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:50 (verifyNoDuplicateKeys, the sibling call in the same try block)
contracts.before_after: Before: verify() read the file once, ran the duplicate-key check and wrapped IOException in MojoExecutionException (lines 49-53). After: verifySafeHtml() reopens the file with FileInputStream and throws RuntimeException on read errors (lines 69-71, 78-80), which the IOException catch does not handle.
contracts.visible_effect: The build fails with 'Validation errors: [...]' listing the messages collected from all files (ThemeVerifierMojo.java:54-55).
contracts.failure_mode: A missing English counterpart or an unreadable file throws a RuntimeException out of ThemeVerifierMojo's loop (ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51). The aggregated report is never printed, so the user sees a raw stack trace and loses the other files' messages.

contracts.action: English counterpart lookup by rewriting the absolute path (resources-community to resources, _xx.properties to _en.properties)
contracts.equivalent_path: themes/pom.xml:64 (the community resource directory that overlays src/main/resources)
contracts.before_after: No existing path does this lookup. The new code rewrites the absolute path with two replaceAll calls and opens the result directly.
contracts.visible_effect: Selects the English string used as the reference for the HTML and anchor checks (lines 85-91, 150).
contracts.failure_mode: A file whose English counterpart is missing throws RuntimeException at line 79. The rewrite applies to the whole absolute path, so a checkout path containing 'resources-community' also changes the lookup.

contracts.action: Sanitize the translated value with the owasp policy, unescape entities, and compare the result with the value; then build the 'Illegal HTML' message
contracts.before_after: New code path. The policy (br, p, strong, b when the English value has HTML; nothing otherwise) is chosen per key at line 91.
contracts.visible_effect: Each violation becomes a message in the build failure (ThemeVerifierMojo.java:54-55). Translations that keep the English markup pass.
contracts.failure_mode: When the sanitized text is shorter and its common prefix and suffix overlap, line 111 computes a negative substring range and throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, aborting the run.

contracts.action: Anchor check: only anchor tags that appear in the English value may appear in the translation
contracts.before_after: New code path. It removes matched anchors from the value before sanitizing, so the sanitizer does not report them.
contracts.visible_effect: A changed href or an extra anchor produces 'Didn't find anchor tag ...' in the build failure. The check stops at the first mismatch (line 158).
contracts.failure_mode: The pattern also matches tags such as <abbr>, which are then compared as anchors (line 145). Anchors after the first mismatch are not checked, but the mismatch already fails the build.

contracts.action: Account UI English key error-invalid-multivalued-size changed to single-brace placeholders with a choice block
contracts.before_after: Before: `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` After: `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}.`
contracts.visible_effect: Account UI text for this error if the key is rendered through i18next. The placeholders would appear unreplaced.
contracts.failure_mode: i18next only interpolates {{ }} placeholders (js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:27-29), so {0} and the choice block would be shown literally.
contracts.open_question: Which UI code calls t() with the error-invalid-multivalued-size key (and whether its params go through i18next), so that the single-brace placeholders are shown raw.
candidates: js/apps/account-ui/src (callers of t() for validation error keys)

contracts.action: Admin UI English key error-invalid-multivalued-size changed to single-brace placeholders with a choice block
contracts.before_after: Before: `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}` placeholders. After: `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` plus a choice block.
contracts.visible_effect: Admin UI text for the multivalued size error, if the key is rendered through i18next.
contracts.failure_mode: The admin UI's i18next instance uses the default {{ }} interpolation (js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13-18), so the single-brace placeholders would not be replaced.
contracts.open_question: Which admin UI code shows this key and passes its parameters through i18next.

contracts.action: Lithuanian and zh_CN account TOTP step 1 text replaced (totpStep1)
contracts.before_after: Before: Lithuanian text with links to FreeOTP and Google Play. After: Italian text (lt) and Traditional Chinese text (zh_CN, messages_zh_CN.properties:112).
contracts.visible_effect: The account TOTP setup page shows the step-1 instruction in the wrong language for Lithuanian users and in Traditional script for zh_CN users.
contracts.failure_mode: Wrong-language text is shown silently; no check flags it.

summary: Reviewed all 46 files of this part. The verifier change is structurally sound, but I found three translation/content errors and two UI-side placeholder regressions, plus several verifier robustness and test gaps. Most findings are on lines the diff shows directly; I read in full only the files I report on, and reviewed the rest from their diff hunks and grep results. Nothing was built or run.
